text: State the split tunnelling tradeoff honestly.
choices: It solves the capacity and performance problem of routing all traffic through a concentrator, at the cost that the device is simultaneously on the corporate network and the open Internet
explanation: Routing every remote worker's Microsoft 365 traffic through a VPN concentrator and back out is tromboning applied to the entire workforce — which caused the widely-reported VPN capacity crises of March 2020.
